================================================================================
Keyword-prefixed word stays whole
================================================================================
ab
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Separate keyword and word
================================================================================
a c
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Explicit keyword-only sequence with a boundary
================================================================================
!a b
---
(program (keyword))

================================================================================
Unsafe state retains its raw keyword
================================================================================
c a
---
(program (word) (keyword))

================================================================================
Negative word precedence does not authorize a keyword-prefix split
:error
================================================================================
!ab
---
(program (ERROR) (word))
